name: Braids
description: Macro oscillator module based on Mutable Instruments Braids by Emilie Gillet, ported from Schwung DSP. An app of Push Hack Home (Shift + Help): open it for on-screen controls and to play it with the pads. The web page sets which pad presses play it and creates its two tracks in Live (an audio track and a MIDI track routed to Braids MIDI In). Renders audio into push-audio-loopback's virtual card. Needs push-audio-loopback, push-manager + push-display, and the PushHack Remote Script (for the tracks and the level meter).
author: federico-pepe
